preconditions.expression: isinstance(stdin, str) and 0 < len(stdin) <= 5_000_000 and all(c.isalnum() for c in stdin)
preconditions.description: stdin is a non-empty string of length at most 5·10⁶, containing only Latin letters and digits (case-sensitive).

postconditions.expression: stdout.isdigit() and int(stdout) == sum(max(k for k in range(0, len(prefix) + 1) if is_k_palindrome(prefix, k)) for prefix in [stdin[:i] for i in range(1, len(stdin) + 1)])
postconditions.description: stdout is the sum of the palindrome degrees of all prefixes of stdin, where the palindrome degree of a string is the maximum k such that the string is a k-palindrome. A string s is a k-palindrome if it is a palindrome and its prefix and suffix of length (len(s) - k) are (k - 1)-palindromes. By definition, any string is a 0-palindrome.
